rows.label: tlk45300451_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I knew this might happen
someday when I chose to leave
my dad and live on my own...

rows.label: tlk45300451_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I'm sad I couldn't be there at the
end.

rows.label: tlk45300451_02_msg0004
rows.name:
You were there for his last
moments, weren't you?

rows.label: tlk45300451_02_msg0005
rows.name: I hope he was happy, at least...

rows.label: tlk45300451_02_msg0006
rows.name:
My dad's hometown is here in Alba
Margen. I really wanted to bring him
back someday.
